description: This file defines the main React component structure for a notes management application, including a top-level component 'InnerApp' that manages notes state, persistence via localStorage, and UI rendering for creating, editing, and deleting notes. It also exports a 'NotesApp' component that wraps 'InnerApp' with theme context.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a reasonably unique ID based on current timestamp and random values.

methods.name: InnerApp
methods.description: Main React functional component managing notes, modal state, theme, and rendering UI.
